question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a silver ball, Bob has a white ball, Claire has a purple ball, Dave has a red ball, Eve has a gold ball, Fred has a blue ball, and Gertrude has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Bob and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Then, Bob and Alice swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Fred and Eve swap balls. Finally, Dave and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Fred has the
Options:
(A) silver ball
(B) white ball
(C) purple ball
(D) red ball
(E) gold ball
(F) blue ball
(G) brown ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in holder order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: silver, white, purple, red, gold, blue, brown
1. Gertrude and Fred swap: silver, white, purple, red, gold, brown, blue
2. Bob and Gertrude swap: silver, blue, purple, red, gold, brown, white
3. Gertrude and Claire swap: silver, blue, white, red, gold, brown, purple
4. Bob and Alice swap: blue, silver, white, red, gold, brown, purple
5. Claire and Eve swap: blue, silver, gold, red, white, brown, purple
6. Fred and Eve swap: blue, silver, gold, red, brown, white, purple
7. Dave and Eve swap: blue, silver, gold, brown, red, white, purple
Fred has the white ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
